description: View ONNX operators and their tensor connections as a graph. Inspect input and output descriptors without running inference. Static parsing within a 32 MiB combined input budget. No inference, Python imports or pickle execution. Reported compatibility is structural, not a guarantee a framework will load a model. Visual preview shows at most 200 nodes; the downloadable report includes up to 5,000 parsed nodes. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: onnx_graph
title: View an ONNX graph
